#!/bin/bash
# exp-010: Start vLLM with Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3
# Non-Qwen architecture for Claim 2 cross-model-family validation
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/start_vllm_mistral_7b.sh          # foreground
#   nohup bash scripts/start_vllm_mistral_7b.sh > /tmp/vllm_mistral7b.log 2>&1 &  # background
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - Model downloaded to /root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3/
#   - Port 8001 must be free (does NOT conflict with Qwen on 8000)

set -e
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0___3"
PORT=8001

if ! [ -f "$MODEL/config.json" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Model not found at $MODEL"
    echo "Download with ModelScope first."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Starting vLLM with Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 on port $PORT ..."

python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --port $PORT \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype auto
EOF
